title: The missed test
explanation: The reason made the letter useful, and the placeholders kept it private, because the assistant never saw a name or an address. Details that were typed into an order have already left your hands, so the safest ones are the ones you never type.
ticket: A short letter to a teacher about a missed test. It gives the reason (a fever) and uses [MY NAME] and [CLASS], so Amara can fill them in later. No real names, addresses, or phone numbers.
promptTemplate: Write a short letter to my teacher about a test I missed.{real}{swap}{reason}

ingredients.label: Real details
ingredients.text: My name is Amara Okonkwo, I live at 14 Palm Road, and my phone number is 555-0142.
ingredients.missingHint: Nothing is missing here. This one is a set of details to keep out of your order.

ingredients.label: Placeholders
ingredients.text: Write it with [MY NAME] and [CLASS] where a name or class would go. I will fill them in myself.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants placeholders she can fill in herself. Your order never asks for them.

ingredients.label: The reason
ingredients.text: The reason is that I had a fever on test day.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants the fever mentioned. Your order never gives the reason.

outputs.base:
Dear Teacher,

I am writing to let you know that I missed the test. I would like to arrange a time to take it. Thank you for understanding.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
outputs.real:
Dear Teacher,

I missed the test and would like to take it on another day.

Sincerely,
Amara Okonkwo
14 Palm Road
Phone: 555-0142
outputs.swap:
Dear Teacher,

I am [MY NAME] from [CLASS]. I missed the test and would like to take it on another day.

Sincerely,
[MY NAME]
outputs.reason:
Dear Teacher,

I missed the test because I had a fever. I would like to take it on another day.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
